name: Viscoelastic Behavior of Bituminous Materials
description: Overview of material behavior-elastic, plastic, viscoelastic, viscoplastic response; aging; issues in representative volume element; mechanical analogs for viscoelastic response; fundamental viscoelastic response-creep compliance, relaxation, complex modulus; interconversion techniques to obtain fundamental viscoelastic responses; time-temperature superposition; linear viscoelastic constitutive equations; elastic-viscoelastic correspondence principle; predicting material behavior-undamaged, damaged state conditions, introduction to nonlinear viscoelasticity, viscoelastoplastic behavoir, fracture mechanics.
